Why This Work Matters to Me

I Didn't Start Here. I Started in the Trenches.

Before Eloquent Digital Solutions, I ran Breeazy Love Shop — an online boutique specializing in trendy, affordable, and high-quality hair accessories, styling tools, and hair care products. I wore a lot of headbands. I have alopecia, and there was a period where headbands were everything for me. That personal need became a business. And that business became my education.

I had real wins — especially during Covid. Pop-up shops, live sales, an influencer program, online selling. I was moving. But I wasn't running a business. I was running activity. And when things got hard post-Covid — shipping nightmares, pricing chaos, vendor issues — I didn't have the foundation to absorb it.

That experience is exactly what I bring to every client. I've been in it. I understand what it feels like to be making moves without the systems to sustain them — and I know what it looks like when you finally build the foundation that changes everything.

The Journey
2019–2022
Breeazy Love Shop
An online boutique specializing in trendy, affordable, and high-quality hair accessories, styling tools, and hair care products. Built through pop-up shops, live sales, e-commerce, and an influencer program — this business was my real education in entrepreneurship.
2020–Present
Women's Empowerment Circle Group
The Women Empowerment Circle Group is a local Michigan-based nonprofit dedicated to uplifting women's mental and emotional well-being. They provide a safe space for community connection, wellness, and self-care experiences — hosting events, book clubs, and meetups throughout the Metro Detroit area.
2022–2023
The Pivot to Marketing
Realized other business owners had great products but no digital presence. Started helping women-owned businesses — then expanded to all established entrepreneurs who needed real support.
2024–2026
Eloquent Digital Marketing
Launched the agency to help established businesses, creatives, and organizations build a powerful digital presence — social media, email, and web all under one roof.
2026–Present
Eloquent Digital Solutions
Rebranded to reflect an expanded mission — shifting from social media management to full digital operations. Because infrastructure is what actually moves the needle.
Right Now
Building Out Loud
Documenting the next chapter of Eloquent Digital Solutions in real time on LinkedIn. Every strategy decision, every pivot, every lesson. Because this generation of entrepreneurs deserves to see the real journey.
What We Do

We're More Than a Marketing Agency.

Eloquent Digital Solutions is your digital operations partner. We help established business owners and creatives build the digital foundation they've been putting off — so they can finally show up consistently, professionally, and with confidence.

Whether you need someone to build your system, run your platforms, train your team, or show up at your live sale — we've got you.

Strategy first, always.

What Is It?

Come Ready to Work.
Leave With Momentum.

Most of us are great at staying busy. Client meetings, committee work, networking events — the calendar fills up fast. But the work that actually moves your business forward? That keeps getting pushed.

You block time for it. Then you move it. Then you fill it with something else.

Focus Flow Hub was built for that exact problem. When you have a dedicated space, a set time, and real people locking in alongside you — everything changes. The accountability isn't forced. It just happens naturally when you're surrounded by people in the same grind.

You don't need another app or another productivity hack. You need a room — physical or virtual — where showing up is the only requirement.
